# pow with an integral exponent, as both runtimes compute it: the base and the
# result as the bits of a double (hex), the exponent in decimal. Every result
# is the double nearest the exact power (checked against exact rationals), and
# a runtime must give these bits on every machine. The same file is in both
# repositories (filo and clang_filo); a change on one belongs on both.
